note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved: admissible_cutoff proves that all literal fixed constants (cstar, ell, T, c3 and the small integers) and all division-polynomial indices fit below T+1, for |c3| < 2^2^24, which c3_lt' proves; recipe_heights gives root height 256. The hypothesis CatalogueBound8 is proved in the repository (ZInQ.catalogueBound8), so it is not an assumption.
